tiles.title: Built a test framework from scratch
tiles.detail: Playwright · scalable, more reliable and maintainable tests
tiles.original: Designed and implemented a scalable Playwright-based automation framework from scratch, significantly improving test reliability and maintainability.

tiles.title: Led the test suite's move to a new tool
tiles.original: Led the migration of the automation suite from Cypress to Playwright, modernizing the testing strategy and improving execution performance.

tiles.title: Helped change how the app gets its data
tiles.detail: REST → GraphQL migration: gaps, schemas, contracts
tiles.original: Contributed to a large-scale REST API to GraphQL migration by identifying and documenting migration gaps, analyzing schemas and API contracts, resolving integration and functionality issues, and supporting builds, deployments, configuration changes, and end-to-end validation.

tiles.title: Contributed to frontend features
tiles.original: Contributed to frontend feature development using Vue.js and GraphQL, resolving integration issues across multiple layers of the application.

tiles.title: Fixed environments that blocked testing
tiles.original: Diagnosed and resolved infrastructure and test environment issues, including Akamai whitelist configuration, collaborating with DevOps to implement and validate fixes and ensure stable test execution across environments.

tiles.title: Put the tests into the release pipeline
tiles.original: Integrated automated test suites into GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, configuring and refining workflows to improve test execution, feedback cycles, and release reliability.

tiles.title: Worked across the team
tiles.detail: DevOps, QA, engineers, PMs, Technical Leads
tiles.original: Evaluated technical trade-offs and aligned implementation strategies with the Technical Lead to drive team-wide decisions. Collaborated closely with Software Engineers, QA, Product Managers, and Technical Leads to improve software quality and accelerate feature delivery.

tiles.title: Wrote down what was learned
tiles.original: Documented technical discoveries, migration findings, implementation details, and best practices in Confluence and Notion, helping preserve knowledge and improve team collaboration.
